newsitem.title: USA: IMF lends Jordan $47 mln more for economic reforms.
newsitem.headline: IMF lends Jordan $47 mln more for economic reforms.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) Tuesday said it had boosted by about $47 million to $331 million the money available to Jordan under its extended fund facility credit for economic and structural reforms.

An IMF statement commended Jordan for its progress in the 1990s toward economic reform, resulting in an increase in average annual growth to around six percent, a drop in inflation to between three and four percent and a steep drop in the external current account deficit to three percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) from almost 20 percent.
It gave no other comparative figures but said the external debt had been halved in terms of GDP.
It said that in light of the improvements, the IMF's Executive Board had approved Jordan's request for more funds.
